investmentsNote: The 10-Q lists 191 investments. 60 of them, holding 4,200 of the 4,530 properties plus the single-family rental homes, give their location only as 'Various' or a non-U.S. place, so they can't be pinned to a state.
thisQuarter: Sold 20 rental housing, 79 self storage and 27 industrial properties for $2.1 billion, exiting self storage entirely.
Put $3.3 billion (at BREIT's share) into data center development through its QTS platform, described as 100% pre-leased.
Raised $1.1 billion from investors and repurchased $0.9 billion of shares and units.

howItWorks.title: How getting money out works
paragraphs: Shares are bought and sold back at a price based on the fund's net asset value, set each month.
The plan limits buybacks to 2% of the fund's NAV per month and 5% per calendar quarter. Shares held under a year are bought back at 98% of the price.
The board can repurchase fewer shares than requested, or none. It has made exceptions to the limits in the past, and can modify or suspend the plan.
